sophia: Quick ping — PR #3124 is blocking the 11:30 merge window. CI is failing on formatting (gofumpt). I pushed a tiny fix but need a quick review/approve so we can land in the window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3124

kevin: on it, fetching the branch. what's the failing check output?

sophia: CI says:
```
ERROR: files with formatting differences:
  pkg/server/handler.go
  cmd/server/main.go
Run `gofumpt -w` to apply fixes.
```
I ran `make format` locally and pushed a commit with the diffs.

lee: quick nit while you're there — rename `resp` -> `response` in handler funcs. small but clearer.

tara: same ask. if you prefer to keep `resp`, add a short comment; otherwise rename and I'll approve. :eyes:

sophia: pushed `rename-resp-to-response` (1 commit). Also squashed and ran `gofumpt -w .` before pushing. PTAL.

ci-bot: CI / fmt-check — success

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests — success

sophia: thanks! planning to merge during the 11:30 slot. tagging release notes: "fix: formatting and handler var rename". If anyone objects speak up now, otherwise I'll merge in 15.

sophia: merging — will post if any post-merge fallout. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
